notes.title: All Hallows' Eve Edition
notes.content:
Hey Chaps,
Let's do something different this Halloween! Draw the curtains, pretend not to be home (the next part's different - I promise) and enjoy a Spooky Halloween Night's Gaming with update 1.0.7 and the rather fetching (and FREE!) Halloween skin.

Do the right thing this Halloween. Your life [i]may[/i]  (it won't! :D) depend on it!
